description: Which formats conved.com converts. Prefer "from" (a format id or file extension, e.g. "docx", "heic"): the target formats for that source. Without arguments: the categories and their number of formats; with "category": the formats of that category (id → name). There are hundreds of formats, so avoid listing everything.

category.description: Category id from the list without arguments, e.g. "document", "image", "audio".

from.description: Source format id or file extension, e.g. "pdf".

name: list_formats
title: List formats
